_comment: WatchdogService: connectivity, restart, missed automations, equipment offline/online. Stored alerts keep the 'Watchdog: ' prefix in English (routes/notifications.js filters on it).
restart_alert: Watchdog: System restarted after {dur} gap (last activity: {at})
internet_outage_detail: Internet has been down since {since} ({dur} so far). Will send recovery report when restored.
internet_lost_detail: Internet went offline at {at}. Recovery report will follow.
missed_daily: Daily automation scheduled for {time} has not fired today. {last}
missed_weekly: Weekly automation ({day} at {time}) has not fired this week. {last}
missed_hourly: Hourly automation (at :{minute}) has not fired this hour. {last}
threshold_met:
Threshold condition met for {minutes}+ minutes ({sensor}: {value} {op} {threshold}{unit}) but automation hasn't fired. {last}
Equipment: {equipment}
equipment_offline_detail: Equipment "{name}" is offline. Last communication: {dur} ago.
equipment_error_detail: Equipment "{name}" has errors. Last communication: {dur} ago.
equipment_error_detail_with_error:
Equipment "{name}" has errors. Last communication: {dur} ago.
Error: {error}
